title: Cup with one on one scheme is the identity on structure-sheaf H1
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], and $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(k)$ a scheme over $k$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base]. Write $U=\mathcal O_X$, $u_X$ for the canonical degree-zero class of one [lem-sc-scalar-unit-cohomology-coordinates], and use scalar module cohomology [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations]. For every $a\in H_k^1(X,U)$, $(\lambda_U)_*(a\cup u_X)=a$ and $(\lambda_U)_*(u_X\cup a)=a$, where the coefficients are $U\otimes U$.

source.place: Cohomology, section-cup-product, Lemma 20.31.1 (Tag 0FKU); Tag 01F7; Modules, Tags 0096 and 01CA

proof.text: Identify the canonical class of one under scalarCohomologyExtEquiv with mk0 scalarUnitMorphism. Use the recorded scalar cohomology coefficient naturality to compare the image under the structure-sheaf left unitor with postcomposition in Ext. Unfold scalarCohomologyCup and cancel its inverse Ext comparison.

Apply the two degree-one scalar Ext cup formulas to the scalar-unit morphism. By associativity of Ext composition and mk0_comp_mk0, the remaining postcomposition is mk0 of the inverse scalar unitor followed by the whiskered scalar unit, scalarTensorCoefficient, and the image of the module left unitor. The tensor-unit coefficient equations reduce these composites to identities; for the right product the module left and right unitors agree at U. Cancel the scalar unitor and use injectivity of scalarCohomologyExtEquiv.

theorem scalar_cup_unit_identities (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :
    let U := SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf
    (∀ a : scalarCohomology f U 1,
      scalarCohomologyMap f (λ_ U).hom 1
        (scalarCohomologyCup f U U 1 0 a (scalarUnitCohomologyClass f)) = a) ∧
    (∀ a : scalarCohomology f U 1,
      scalarCohomologyMap f (λ_ U).hom 1
        (scalarCohomologyCup f U U 0 1 (scalarUnitCohomologyClass f) a) = a)
